create_barplotdata: create a BarPlotData dataclass instance with x, x0, x1, height, and width fields
configure_barplotconfig: configure a BarPlotConfig with x_field, y_field, style dict, and external_timer settings
build_barplot: build a BarPlot node that subscribes to a topic and visualizes data as a bar plot
update_barplot: update the bar plot display by calling update to refresh BarGraphItem options with new data
stop_barplot: stop the bar plot node timer by calling the stop method on the BarPlot instance
